# intention goal

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:intentionGoal`](gmeow-intentionGoal.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/intentionGoal>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/teleology`](../../slices/teleology.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The goal at which a desire, intention, or commitment aims — its propositional content. Functional: one mode, one goal; an agent pursuing five goals bears five modes. Sharing is at the [`Goal`](../classes/gmeow-Goal.md): two agents committed to the same outcome hold distinct modes aiming at one [`Goal`](../classes/gmeow-Goal.md) individual.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:IntentionalMoment`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionalMoment.md) -> [`gmeow:Goal`](../classes/gmeow-Goal.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:intentionGoal`](gmeow-intentionGoal.md) from [`gmeow:IntentionalMoment`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionalMoment.md) to [`gmeow:Goal`](../classes/gmeow-Goal.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Goal And Intention

- **Source:** [`slices/core/teleology/examples/goal-and-intention.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/teleology/examples/goal-and-intention.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-teleology-examples-goal-and-intention)#example-slices-core-teleology-examples-goal-and-intention

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: goals, intentions, and commitments. GMEOW separates the
# intentional moments gUFO keeps distinct: a gmeow:Goal is the SocialObject an
# agent aims at (gmeow:hasGoal); a gmeow:Intention is an intentional MODE borne by
# an agent that aims at that goal (gmeow:intentionGoal) and MOTIVATES concrete
# action (gmeow:motivates → an Event); a gmeow:Commitment is a relator binding a
# committed agent to a beneficiary. The desire-to / intend-to / commit-to layers
# are not collapsed — each is its own first-class moment.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/teleology/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

# --- The intention: an intentional mode borne by Dana, aimed at the goal, that
#     motivates a concrete action (the graduation event).
ex:intention a gmeow:Intention ;
    gmeow:intentBearer  ex:dana ;
    gmeow:intentionGoal ex:degreeGoal ;
    gmeow:motivates     ex:graduation .
```

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:IntentionalMoment`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionalMoment.md), [`gmeow:Goal`](../classes/gmeow-Goal.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind any intentional moment — [`Desire`](../classes/gmeow-Desire.md), [`Intention`](../classes/gmeow-Intention.md), or [`Commitment`](../classes/gmeow-Commitment.md) — to the single [`Goal`](../classes/gmeow-Goal.md) it aims at; the property whose named domain ([`gmeow:IntentionalMoment`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionalMoment.md)) spans both branches.

### Avoid when

- Avoid aiming one moment at several goals (it is functional — an agent pursuing five goals bears five modes) and avoid duplicating the [`Goal`](../classes/gmeow-Goal.md) per agent; sharing happens at one [`Goal`](../classes/gmeow-Goal.md) individual.

### How to use

- Point each moment at exactly one [`gmeow:Goal`](../classes/gmeow-Goal.md) and let multiple agents' modes converge on the same [`Goal`](../classes/gmeow-Goal.md) individual; decompose composite goals as separate Goals linked by the mereology spine rather than overloading this property.

### Examples

- ex:planToShip [`gmeow:intentionGoal`](gmeow-intentionGoal.md) ex:reachOrbit.
